title: 第15章改善生活-《穿越60带着空间当保安》
content:
第(1/3)页

    一转眼，王铁柱、赵爷爷和刘叔一起回到了院子，王铁柱看见王野在院子里看着弟弟妹妹玩儿，阴阳怪气的说：“哟！我大儿子舍得回来啦？”

    王野撇着嘴说：“老爹，你这么说话就没意思了，我要是前天和你一起回来，你就惨了。你不说谢谢我，还挖苦我。”

    王铁柱没有回话，逗弄了几句王笑笑就被秦婉叫进了屋里，王野知道这是要说野猪的事儿，也就跟进屋里。

    秦婉把事情说了一遍问：“当家的，你说说怎么处理吧！”

    王铁柱倒像是经验丰富的样子：“这有啥的？下水和猪头晚上卤了，叫上院里人一起吃一顿，一家再给一斤肉，告诉大家野猪是小野打到的。剩下的咱怎么弄都行。”

    秦婉点头应道：“嗯，还是当家的想的周到。”说完秦婉就去招呼邻居们了。

    没一会儿所有人都聚到了院子里，除了李叔还没有下班。大家一起支锅的支锅，打水的打水。一起忙的不亦乐乎。

    孩子们知道有肉吃，更是高兴的不得了。只有李奶奶悄悄的把大门关上，还给插上门闩。

    王野：“李奶奶，我李叔还没回来呢！这是不让他进门啦？”

    李奶奶神神秘秘的说：“小野呀，这门可得关好了，谁叫都不能开。”

    王野调笑道：“那行，的我李叔回来让他翻墙。”

    李奶奶笑着说：“你个臭小子！就会逗奶奶开心。”

    因为猪肉是王野在空间里处理的，非常干净。很快，猪头、骨头和下水就下锅了。刘叔和李奶奶家也各拿出来了两斤棒子面。这可是一家人好几天的口粮。这就看出来这个院人的人性了。谁家也不愿意白占人家便宜。

    王野调笑道：“赵爷爷，李奶奶和刘叔都拿棒子面了，你咋不拿呀？”

    赵爷爷理不直气也壮：“我就不拿，你能拿我咋办！”

    王野嘿嘿笑两声：“呦呦，这老头还挺横！”

    王铁柱板着脸说：“怎么跟你赵爷爷说话呢！你赵爷爷拿了一瓶好酒。小屁孩子，哪儿都有你。”

    赵爷爷露出得逞的笑容：“挨骂了吧？让你个臭小子和老头聊闲。”

    王野不甘示弱的说：“赵爷爷，我这儿还有好东西，你想要吗？”

    王野拿出三爷爷给的药丸，在赵爷爷面前晃悠。赵爷爷伸手去拿。王野一搭手和赵爷爷来回推了两手。赵爷爷满脸吃惊的看着王野。

    王野也不说话，用一脸得意又肯定的眼神看着赵爷爷。赵爷爷看向王野手中的瓷瓶。王野嘴角微微上翘轻轻点了下头。

    王铁柱看了一脸懵说：“赵大爷，你们祖孙儿打什么哑谜呢？”

    赵爷爷正好奇王野的变化，王铁柱过来打岔，便没好气的说：“咋滴，我们干啥碍着你干活了？”

    王铁柱气的叉腰：“嘿，你这老爷子！我帮你，你还熊我。”

    赵爷爷：“我用你帮了吗？”

    王铁柱一脸憋闷的蹲在灶边。

    秦婉走过来说：“人家祖孙儿的事儿，没事儿插什么嘴呀？”

    因为那天早上，秦婉看见赵爷爷教王野打拳了，觉得人家爷俩儿的关系，肯定比王铁柱要好。

    王铁柱无奈的说：“合着我是猪八戒照镜子，里外不是人呗？”

    秦婉白了王铁柱一眼：“你以为呢？”

    王铁柱郁闷的继续烧火，满院子的大人欢声笑语。

    赵爷爷：“小野跟我回屋。”说完就回自己的小屋去了，王野对着王铁柱耸了耸肩转头跟了上去。

    王铁柱对旁边的秦婉说：“我真想揍他一顿。”

    秦婉说：“咋滴，吃着我大儿子带回来的肉，还想打我大儿子。你是不是想我回去跟咱娘念叨念叨。”

    进到赵爷爷的小屋，赵爷爷指着桌子上的瓷瓶说：“解释解释吧！”
    第(1/3)页

In a blink of an eye, Wang Tiezhu, Grandpa Zhao and Uncle Liu returned to the yard together. Wang Tiezhu saw Wang Ye watching his younger siblings playing in the yard, and said angrily: "Hey! Is my eldest son willing to come back?"

Wang Ye curled his lips and said, "Dad, it's boring for you to talk like this. If I came back with you the day before yesterday, you would be miserable. You didn't say thank you to me, and you made fun of me."

Wang Tiezhu didn't reply. After teasing Wang Xiaoxiao for a few words, Qin Wan called him into the room. Wang Ye knew that he was talking about the wild boar, so he followed him into the room.

Qin Wan explained the matter and asked: "Master, please tell me how to deal with it!"

Wang Tiezhu seemed to have a lot of experience: "What's the point? I've stewed the pig's head and pig's head at night, and asked the people in the upper courtyard to have a meal together, and then give a pound of meat to everyone, telling everyone that Xiaoye shot the wild boar. We can do whatever we want with the rest."

Qin Wan nodded and said, "Well, the head of the family is more thoughtful." After saying that, Qin Wan went to greet the neighbors.

After a while, everyone gathered in the yard, except Uncle Li who hadn’t gotten off work yet.Everyone supports the pot together, and those who draw water draw water together.It was a pleasure to be busy together.

The children were even more happy when they knew there was meat to eat.Only Grandma Li quietly closed the door and bolted it.

Wang Ye: "Grandma Li, my Uncle Li hasn't come back yet! Are you not letting him in?"

Grandma Li said mysteriously: "Xiaoye, this door must be closed, no one can open it."

Wang Ye said with a smile: "Okay, I, Uncle Li, will come back and let him climb over the wall."

Grandma Li smiled and said, "You brat! You will make grandma happy."

Because the pork was processed by Wang Ye in the space, it was very clean.Soon, the pig head, bones and offal were put into the pot.Uncle Liu and Grandma Li each brought out two kilograms of stick noodles.This is enough food for a family for several days.This shows the humanity of this hospital man.No one wants to take advantage of others in vain.

Wang Ye joked: "Grandpa Zhao, Grandma Li and Uncle Liu all got stick noodles, why don't you get them?"

Grandpa Zhao was unreasonable and confident: "I won't take it, what can you do to me!"

Wang Ye chuckled twice: "Hey, this old man is quite arrogant!"

Wang Tiezhu said with a straight face: "Why are you talking to your Grandpa Zhao! Your Grandpa Zhao has brought a bottle of good wine. Little brat, you are everywhere."

Grandpa Zhao showed a successful smile: "Did you get scolded? Let you, a brat, chat with the old man."

Wang Ye said not to be outdone: "Grandpa Zhao, I have some good things here, do you want them?"

Wang Ye took out the pills given by Third Grandpa and waved them in front of Grandpa Zhao.Grandpa Zhao reached for it.Wang Ye put his hands together and pushed Grandpa Zhao back and forth.Grandpa Zhao looked at Wang Ye with surprise.

Wang Ye didn’t say anything, and looked at Grandpa Zhao with a proud and affirmative look.Grandpa Zhao looked at the porcelain bottle in Wang Ye's hand.The corners of Wang Ye's mouth turned up slightly and he nodded slightly.

Wang Tiezhu looked confused and said, "Uncle Zhao, what kind of riddles do your grandparents and grandchildren play?"

Grandpa Zhao was curious about Wang Ye's changes. Wang Tiezhu came to interrupt and said angrily: "Why, what are we doing to hinder your work?"

Wang Tiezhu put his hands on his hips angrily: "Hey, you old man! I help you, but you still bear with me."

Grandpa Zhao: “Did I use your help?”

Wang Tiezhu squatted by the stove with a depressed look on his face.

Qin Wan came over and said, "It's about my grandparents and grandchildren. Why do you want to interrupt me when it's nothing?"

Because that morning, Qin Wan saw Grandpa Zhao teaching Wang Ye boxing, and felt that their relationship must be better than that of Wang Tiezhu.

Wang Tiezhu said helplessly: "I am Zhu Bajie. When I look in the mirror, am I not a human being inside or outside?"

Qin Wan rolled her eyes at Wang Tiezhu: "What do you think?"

Wang Tiezhu continued to light the fire depressedly, while the adults in the yard laughed happily.

Grandpa Zhao: "Xiaoye, follow me back to the house." After saying that, he went back to his cabin. Wang Ye shrugged at Wang Tiezhu and turned to follow him.

Wang Tiezhu said to Qin Wan next to him: "I really want to beat him up."

Qin Wan said: "Why, you are eating the meat my eldest son brought back, and you want to beat my eldest son. Do you want me to go back and talk to my mother about it?"

Entering Grandpa Zhao’s hut, Grandpa Zhao pointed to the porcelain bottle on the table and said, “Explain it!”
